purpose: Determine on non-NIST bytes whether a deliberately truncated Deflate64 ZIP can yield a trustworthy decompressed prefix for container-header inspection without downloading the complete member.

result.decoderError: Unexpected end of archive; Data Error

admissibleUse: A truncated Deflate64 decode may be used only to read structures that end before a conservative discarded tail. On real data, decode two nested compressed-prefix lengths, discard at least 65536 emitted tail bytes, and require the retained prefixes and parsed counters to be byte-identical. Decoder error is expected and never treated as archive integrity success.
notEstablished: That the NIST AVI header lies inside the decoded prefix
That two prefix lengths will produce stable retained bytes on the NIST member
Any NIST trigger count, frame count, frame identity, or missing-slot placement
Portability to a different Deflate64 decoder or 7-Zip version
